column2: Japan's Labour Standards Act sets 8-hour days, 40-hour weeks, minimum 10 days paid leave (rising with tenure), overtime caps (45hr/month), and restrictions on dismissal. Lifetime employment culture.

China's Labour Contract Law requires written contracts, limits overtime to 36hr/month, mandates social insurance, provides 5-15 days annual leave based on tenure, and requires severance for termination.
India consolidated 29 labor laws into 4 codes (2020): Wages, Industrial Relations, Social Security, and Occupational Safety. Minimum wage varies by state, 48-hour workweek standard.

column1: What is South Korean labor law?
column2: South Korea's Labor Standards Act provides 52-hour weekly cap (40 regular + 12 overtime), 15 days annual leave, severance of 30 days pay per year worked, and strong union rights.

Singapore's Employment Act covers workers earning up to $4,500/month. Provides: 7-14 days annual leave, 60 days hospitalization leave, overtime for manual workers, and termination notice requirements.
